```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(openair)
```

```{r find-files}
greywolf_files <- list.files(
  "data/raw/Graywolf_Data",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

length(greywolf_files)
basename(greywolf_files)

mass_files <- greywolf_files[
  grepl("particulate|Indoor|Outdoor", basename(greywolf_files), ignore.case = TRUE)
]

basename(mass_files)
```

```{r inspect-timestamps}
# Pick one indoor and one outdoor CSV
indoor_file <- greywolf_files[
  grepl("Indoor", basename(greywolf_files), ignore.case = TRUE)
][1]

outdoor_file <- greywolf_files[
  grepl("Outdoor", basename(greywolf_files), ignore.case = TRUE)
][1]

indoor_test <- read_csv(indoor_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
outdoor_test <- read_csv(outdoor_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

names(indoor_test)
head(indoor_test, 10)

names(outdoor_test)
head(outdoor_test, 10)
```

```{r import-and-pair-pm25}

# Find only particulate-mass CSV files
pm_files <- greywolf_files[
  str_detect(
    greywolf_files,
    regex("particulate_mass", ignore_case = TRUE)
  )
]

# Import PM2.5 from all particulate-mass files
pm_all <- map_dfr(pm_files, \(f) {

  x <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)

  tibble(
    date = dmy_hms(x[["Date Time"]]),
    pm25 = x[["2.5µm  µg/m3"]],

    location = if_else(
      str_detect(f, regex("indoor", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      "indoor",
      "outdoor"
    ),

    school = case_when(
      str_detect(basename(f), "SCH1|SC1") ~ "School 1",
      str_detect(basename(f), "SCH2|SC2") ~ "School 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
})

# Match indoor and outdoor PM2.5 by school and minute
paired_pm25 <- pm_all |>
  mutate(date = floor_date(date, "minute")) |>
  group_by(school, location, date) |>
  summarise(
    pm25 = mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = location,
    values_from = pm25
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(indoor),
    !is.na(outdoor)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = indoor - outdoor,
    io_ratio = indoor / outdoor
  ) |>
  arrange(school, date)

paired_pm25

```

```{r check-sampling-coverage}

paired_pm25 |>
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(date)) |>
  count(school, sample_date, name = "paired_minutes") |>
  arrange(school, sample_date)
```


```{r plot-one-day-school1}

timePlot(
  paired_pm25 |>
    filter(
      school == "School 1",
      as.Date(date) == as.Date("2026-07-06")
    ),
  pollutant = c("indoor", "outdoor"),
  group = TRUE,
  ylab = expression(PM[2.5]~(mu*g/m^3)),
  title = "School 1 — 6 July 2026",
  key.position = "top"
)

```
```{r school1-three-days}

school1_pm25 <- paired_pm25 |>
  filter(school == "School 1") |>
  mutate(sample_date = format(as.Date(date), "%d %B %Y"))

timePlot(
  school1_pm25,
  pollutant = c("indoor", "outdoor"),
  group = TRUE,
  type = "sample_date",
  layout = c(1, 3),
  scales = "free_x",
  ylab = expression(PM[2.5]~(mu*g/m^3)),
  title = "School 1 — PM2.5 indoor and outdoor",
  key.position = "top"
)

```

```{r school1-summary}

school1_summary <- paired_pm25 |>
  filter(school == "School 1") |>
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(date)) |>
  group_by(sample_date) |>
  summarise(
    paired_minutes = n(),
    mean_indoor = mean(indoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_outdoor = mean(outdoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_indoor = median(indoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_outdoor = median(outdoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_difference = mean(difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_io_ratio = median(io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_indoor_above_outdoor = mean(indoor > outdoor, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2)))

school1_summary

```

```{r daily-indoor-outdoor-relationship}

daily_relationship <- paired_pm25 |>
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(date)) |>
  group_by(school, sample_date) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    correlation = cor(indoor, outdoor, use = "complete.obs"),
    p_value = cor.test(indoor, outdoor, method = "pearson")$p.value,
    slope = coef(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))[2],
    intercept = coef(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))[1],
    r_squared = summary(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))$r.squared,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(correlation, slope, intercept, r_squared), \(x) round(x, 3)),
    p_value = format.pval(p_value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
  )

daily_relationship

```
